description: Raise an issue on a task (POST /tasks/:id/issues), the way an admin does it in TaScan: status OPEN, source admin, the description as the first thread message. category DELAY, MISSING_MATERIALS, SAFETY_CONCERN, EQUIPMENT_ISSUE, WEATHER, PERSONNEL, QUALITY or OTHER (default); severity LOW, MEDIUM (default), HIGH or CRITICAL. Write tier.
